name: 28743 · Hot Springs, NC
findings: ZIP 28743 (Hot Springs) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28743 (Hot Springs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
